aiSummary: 今日聚焦国际政治领域。热点议题包括：HCP: Morocco’s Economy Grows by；Big；US: Global Health Aid Tied。本日共收录 10 条重要国际新闻。

articles.title: HCP: Morocco’s Economy Grows by 4.9% in 2025
articles.description: Morocco’s economy recorded GDP growth of 4.9% in 2025, up from 4.4% in 2024, according the High Commission for Planning (HCP).

articles.title: Big-Hearted Giving
articles.description: Each of you should give what you have decided in your heart to give. — 2 Corinthians 9:7

articles.title: US: Global Health Aid Tied to Harmful Conditions
articles.description: The United States government is conditioning lifesaving health assistance on broad access to surveillance data and extractive rights to pathogen samples and data for pharmaceutical development.

articles.title: The Signs We Refuse to See: Why Uganda’s Sovereignty Act Cannot Cure Our National Despair
articles.description: Uganda's 2026 Protection of Sovereignty Act criminalises civic action under the banner of national defence. The state is punishing the signs of distress.

articles.title: New Zealand Announces New Work Visa Opportunities for International Graduates, Outlines Conditions
articles.description: New Zealand introduces a six-month Short-Term Graduate Work Visa for foreign graduates, enabling job searches post-study while expanding Post Study Work Visa access.
